verdict.rationale: Browserbase's docs describe full programmatic browser control with auto-waits, network interception, multi-tab support, and natural-language/self-healing actions (Stagehand SDK) that handle forms, logins, and CAPTCHAs — directly enabling scripted click/fill/scroll interactions before returning content. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of specific scroll/fill/click code examples and no public API reference/OpenAPI spec confirming exact interaction primitives.
